tip.no-clicks: {views} people viewed your page but no one clicked a link. Your call-to-action is not converting.
tip.low-ctr: Only {pct}% of visitors interact with your page. Strengthen your call-to-action.
tip.no-leads: There are clicks ({clicks}) but no one is leaving their details. There is no clear way to get in touch.
tip.healthy: Your page is converting well: {views} visits, {leads} leads. Keep sharing it.
tip.insufficient: Too few visits ({views}) for a recommendation yet. Share your page and check back.

instruction.no-clicks: Make the main call-to-action far more visible and persuasive: move it above the fold, raise its contrast, and improve the button text so it invites a click.
instruction.low-ctr: Strengthen the main call-to-action: make it more prominent with clearer, more persuasive text, and reduce surrounding distractions so more visitors click.
instruction.no-leads: Add a short lead-capture form (name and email) right next to the main call-to-action, or simplify the existing form so it takes less effort to leave details.
